prompt: Who was the Argentinian president who resigned from the position the same year the José Martín Olaeta Stadium was inaugurated?
answer: The Argentinian president was **Pedro Pablo Ramírez**, who resigned in **1944**, the year the José Martín Olaeta Stadium was inaugurated.
